brief:
Benjamin Netanyahu's party and that of rival Gadi Eisenkot concluded talks on Sunday without reaching an agreement on forming a government, Middle East Eye reported. The two sides have been negotiating a potential coalition arrangement as Israel seeks to end its political stalemate.

The failed round of negotiations marks another setback in efforts to establish a stable governing coalition. Both Netanyahu, serving as caretaker prime minister, and Eisenkot remain central figures in Israeli political negotiations.

title: Netanyahu and Eisenkot end coalition talks without deal
